finding.headline: "The Skipped Sterilizer"
finding.problem: "The Bump says I don't need a sterilizer. But our water comes from a tank and I don't trust it. Do I buy the machine or boil water? I don't know what's safe here."
finding.person: Mum who read conflicting advice: AAP says soap-and-water is fine with safe water; Nigerian borehole water isn't safe to trust.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module / Standalone (water-context sterilizing).". Verdict: PASSES (4/5) —.
